text: OVERDOSAGE Topically applied corticosteroids can be absorbed in sufficient amounts to produce systemic effects (See PRECAUTIONS). DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Shake well before using. A small quantity of Nolix ® Lotion should be rubbed gently into the affected area 2 or 3 times daily. Therapy should be discontinued when control is achieved. If no improvement is seen within 2 weeks, reassessment of the diagnosis may be necessary. Nolix ® Lotion should not be used with occlusive dressings unless directed by a physician. Tight-fitting diapers or plastic pants may constitute occlusive dressings.
